title: Convex sets are closed under mixed-strategy averages
statement: Let $S \subseteq \bbr$ be a convex set, let $p$ be a mixed strategy over $n$ actions with weights $p_1, \dots, p_n \ge 0$ satisfying $\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i = 1$, and let $x_1, \dots, x_n \in S$. Then the weighted average $\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i\, x_i$ again lies in $S$.
hypotheses_covered: S is a convex subset of the reals
p is a mixed strategy over n actions (weights nonnegative, summing to 1)
each point x_i lies in S
replaced:
If $S \subseteq \bbr$ is convex, $p \in \Delta_n$ is a mixed strategy, and
$x_1,\dots,x_n \in S$, then
$\sum_{i} p_i\, x_i \in S$.
